accounting.rationale: Original PDF126 lines29-33 defines dummy-array and RANK(*) associate contexts, distinguishes size from rank/extents, and names two declaration forms. No standalone no-op definition execution is created.
The usual category is a dummy argument array; declaration-role constraints apply to their actual forms, not indiscriminately to every construct associate.
The detailed size rules are p2 and sequence association. This description does not authorize an ordinary whole SIZE/SHAPE query or erase element/character-sequence qualifications.

PENDING exact canonical11.1.10 association: RANK(*) matches assumed-size association, and its associate is rank1 as if DIMENSION(1:*). C1160 excludes POINTER/ALLOCATABLE selectors. Do not reject this expressly allowed associate for not being a declared dummy.
Rank difference requires a conforming argument/sequence-association context, including the specific-versus-generic call and actual-argument restrictions. It is not universal rank-mismatch permission.
Explicit leading extents need not copy effective-argument extents. Safe element access must still remain within the available sequence.
R824 supplies the explicit scalar prefix and final assumed-implied specification; it is not an all-star implied-shape declaration.
R825's single assumed-implied specification has dummy or named-constant roles under C837; the role decides assumed size versus implied shape.
The prefix is an explicit-shape-spec-list, not the R818 vector-bounds alternative.

PDF127 lines3-15 gives four size branches. Exact size is not an ordinary whole-array inquiry result. Positive-length character formulas require the separately read sequence rules, including their zero-length case.
Character storage units and their order are language concepts here, not assumed bytes, encodings or graphics.
PDF127 lines17-18 separates absent last upper/extent/full shape from the prohibition on contexts that require that shape.
No ordinary last-dimension upper bound is supplied; a forwarded inquiry sentinel is not a recovered upper bound.
The last extent is unavailable, even if a caller knows the actual element count. Do not infer it from a destination or prefix product.
There is no full shape of the ordinary assumed-size array. An explicitly bounded section and an assumed-rank inquiry have their own rules.
PDF127 lines19-21 gives known prefix/last-lower bounds and a separate subscript/section permission.

PENDING safe known-sequence accesses and explicitly bounded sections under9.5.3, including C930/C931's last-section upper limit. Do not omit that limit, probe an unavailable boundary or create a separate no-op permission case.

requirements.title: An assumed-implied specification has a star and an optional lower-bound colon
requirements.definition: The assumed-implied-spec is an asterisk optionally preceded by a lower-bound and its colon. R824, R825 and R826 place it in different larger forms. The star is not an integer upper bound, and lower-bound retains R816's scalar specification-expression contract.

pending.bare-star: PENDING complete dummy and named-constant admissions using the appropriate containing forms, with no guessed extent from '*'. Choose a canonical owner for overlapping grammar/role evidence rather than duplicate executions.
pending.specified-lower-star: PENDING x(-2:*) as a genuine dummy declaration and v(-2:*) as a PARAMETER declaration with a rank-one constant initializer. Negative lower bounds are permitted; named-constant bounds additionally obey C853.
pending.missing-lower-control: PENDING a complete dummy declaration x(:*) repaired only to x(*), after excluding every valid R814 alternative. Require the actual missing lower-bound/colon-star grammar cause. Header-versus-declaration reporting remains gated by C830-ANCHOR-001; do not coalesce lines or widen a contiguous span.

requirements.oracle: Finite syntax admissions and a minimally repaired malformed candidate in a complete role-valid unit. Shared spelling does not determine whether the entity is assumed size or implied shape.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Numbered reporting capability is not mandated fatal exit, exact English or a printed code. Unsupported facilities, ICE/verifier failures, source echoes, generic expected-token/EOF recovery and wrong-source reports do not count. Disjoint diagnostic anchors are an open infrastructure gate.

requirements.title: The assumed-size form has an explicit scalar prefix and a final assumed-implied specification
requirements.definition: An assumed-size-spec combines a nonempty explicit-shape-spec-list, a comma and one final assumed-implied-spec. Thus this form has at least two dimensions. The single-star form is R825; a multi-star implied-shape form is R826. R818 vector bounds are not the scalar prefix production.

pending.one-prefix: PENDING a complete INTEGER dummy x(2,-2:*) and valid specific-procedure association. Rank/bounds runs are separate from syntax admission; no full SIZE/SHAPE query.
pending.multiple-prefix: PENDING x(2,3,*) in a complete dummy/interface context with independently sufficient defined actual data. Do not interpret an earlier '*' as an explicit scalar bound.
pending.vector-prefix-excluded: PENDING a dummy x([2],*) candidate repaired only to x(2,*). Establish the required scalar R815 prefix and exclude alternative whole array-spec parses before a causal report. Keep ordinary vector-bound feature failures and C830-ANCHOR-001 location handling separate.
pending.bound-expression-source: PENDING exact R815-R817/C831 and10.1.11 premises for prefix bounds and R823's final lower bound. Prior typing, nonoptional non-INTENT(OUT) bound dummies and constant-property inquiries retain their actual rules; no cloned scalar-bound negatives.

requirements.oracle: Complete prefix-form admissions and one focused scalar-prefix contrast, with a minimal valid repair and exact source relation.
requirements.oracle_limitation: A valid multi-star named-constant alternative cannot be called an R824 syntax error merely because a different parse was intended. No fatal/code/English policy, broad type/constant strings, unsupported-feature credit or source-span workaround.

requirements.title: The explicit-prefix assumed-size declaration requires a dummy data object
requirements.definition: An object whose bounds are specified by assumed-size-spec is a dummy data object. This is the explicit-prefix R824 form, not a universal ban on the RANK(*) associate explicitly defined elsewhere, and not permission to use that prefix form for an ordinary local or named constant.

pending.dummy-admission: PENDING a complete explicit-interface ordinary INTEGER dummy with scalar prefix and final star, using valid type/kind and sequence association conditions.
pending.nondummy-excluded: PENDING a subroutine p() containing ordinary INTEGER x(2,*), repaired only by adding x to the dummy list. Do not add another defect through initialization, undefined body reads or an invalid type. The absence-from-dummy-list predicate and legitimate header/declaration report sites need C830-ANCHOR-001 support before implementation.
pending.construct-and-shared-form-boundary: PENDING the exact R824 declaration subject versus R825's named-constant branch and the canonical RANK(*) associate. Adding PARAMETER is not a repair for a prefix-form declaration; do not reject a legal construct associate for not being a declared dummy.

requirements.oracle: One focused role exclusion with a header-only dummy-role repair and valid admissions. Canonical syntax and association rules remain independently required.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No fatal status or code is mandated. Bind a case-specific dummy-role cause to legitimate disjoint sites; unsupported syntax, unrelated initialization, ICE, source echo and broad whole-procedure spans cannot supply credit.

requirements.title: An INTENT(OUT) assumed-size array excludes four type properties
requirements.definition: An assumed-size array with INTENT(OUT) is neither polymorphic nor finalizable, has no allocatable ultimate component, and is not of a type with specified default initialization. Each property and the OUT/assumed-size premises matter. The rule does not exempt zero-size actuals or prohibit the same type in every other dummy category or intent.

pending.polymorphic-exclusion: PENDING a regular module procedure with CLASS(t),INTENT(OUT)::x(*) for a prior simple extensible type t without finalization, allocatable components or default initialization. Repair only OUT to INOUT. Do not use TYPE(*), whose independent C714 restriction also forbids OUT.
pending.finalizable-exclusion: PENDING TYPE(t),INTENT(OUT)::x(*) in a regular procedure, where t has one valid module FINAL procedure with an INOUT dummy, no default initialization and no allocatable component. Repair only the regular procedure's OUT to INOUT. Do not make the final subroutine itself the invalid OUT procedure or clone C791's distinct violation.
pending.allocatable-ultimate-exclusion: PENDING direct and nested nonpointer/nonallocatable-component routes to an INTEGER ALLOCATABLE ultimate component, without FINAL or component-initialization. In the ordinary assumed-size OUT dummy, change only OUT to INOUT for the repair. Implicit unallocated status is not specified default initialization under7.5.4.6p8.
pending.default-initialization-exclusion: PENDING a nonpolymorphic nonfinalizable type with an INTEGER component initialized to17, but no allocatable ultimate component, used for x(*) with OUT. Repair only OUT to INOUT. Any nested default-initialization variant must follow the actual direct-component definition, not an initializer on an unrelated variable.
pending.non-out-admissions: PENDING valid ordinary assumed-size IN/INOUT controls retaining each relevant type property and all interface/type/rank/definability premises. No finalization/default-initialization runtime effect is inferred from their compile admission.
pending.zero-size-and-reporting-gate: PENDING source confirmation that an empty actual does not remove this declaration constraint. Each of the four negative/control families requires its own cause and separate legitimate procedure-header/declaration anchors under C830-ANCHOR-001; no line coalescing, span widening or generic type/OUT message.

requirements.oracle: Four isolated type-property exclusions with otherwise valid type definitions and OUT-to-INOUT repairs. The finalizer, ultimate-component and default-initialization definitions retain their canonical owners.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Required reporting capability does not mandate a fatal exit or exact wording/code. Feature-not-implemented messages for polymorphism, finalization or components do not count as C836 reports. Original C714/C791 cases and roles remain unchanged; disjoint-anchor support is not fabricated.

requirements.title: The shared single-star form is one assumed-implied specification
requirements.definition: An implied-shape-or-assumed-size-spec consists of one assumed-implied-spec. It is distinct from the nonempty explicit prefix of R824 and the multiple assumed-implied specifications of R826. C837 supplies the genuine dummy or named-constant declaration roles.

pending.dummy-form: PENDING a complete ordinary INTEGER dummy x(*) or x(-2:*), with a conforming specific-procedure call and no full ordinary assumed-size inquiry.
pending.named-constant-form: PENDING INTEGER,PARAMETER::v(*)=[11,13] and v(-2:*)=[11,13], with a rank-one constant initializer and constant lower bound. They have implied shape, not a runtime-associated unknown last extent.
pending.role-resolution-source: PENDING exact C837/C838 and11.1.10 RANK(*) source relationships. Preserve a single canonical owner for overlapping syntax/role witnesses; a declaration-only no-op or cloned case does not complete both facets.

requirements.oracle: Complete role-valid admissions of the same grammar, with separate meaningful bound/rank effects under the corresponding prose owners.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No inference that '*' denotes scalar rank zero, optional support or an arbitrary bound value. Negative grammar claims must exclude valid alternatives and respect the disjoint-anchor gate, without compiler consensus.

requirements.title: A shared single-star declaration is for a dummy data object or named constant
requirements.definition: An object declared with the shared implied-shape-or-assumed-size form is a dummy data object or a named constant. These alternatives are not interchangeable with an ordinary local variable, array result or component. The explicitly defined RANK(*) construct associate retains its canonical semantics.

pending.dummy-admission: PENDING a complete x(*) dummy declaration under R825/R823 with valid actual association; no initialization on the dummy and no shape-requiring body use.
pending.named-constant-admission: PENDING the same single-star shape grammar with PARAMETER, a mandatory constant array initializer of matching rank, and C853-valid bounds/type parameters. A variable initializer or scalar initializer is not automatically a legal named-constant repair.
pending.ordinary-variable-excluded: PENDING subroutine p() with an ordinary INTEGER x(*), repaired only by adding x to the dummy list. A separately reviewed PARAMETER repair must also supply a valid constant initializer. Require the actual role predicate and hold implementation for C830-ANCHOR-001 if header/declaration sites differ.

requirements.oracle: Focused ordinary-variable exclusion and complete dummy/named-constant controls. No local-variable admission is invented from the shared spelling.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No scalar/result/component shortcut, broad diagnostic span, forced fatal exit or generic constant/expected string. C838/8.2/C853 initializer and type obligations retain their own predicates and owners; no cloned repairs.

requirements.title: Assumed size follows the qualified effective-array or element/storage sequence
requirements.source: 8.5.8.5 p2 and four bullets, physical PDF127, lines3-15
requirements.definition: For an effective array of a type other than default CHARACTER, size is taken from that array; for a qualifying actual element at order r in an array of size x it is x-r+1. The stated default-CHARACTER array/element/element-substring rule is MAX(INT((c-t+1)/e),0), using the starting character storage unit t, array count c and dummy element length e. The other default-CHARACTER scalar rule is MAX(INT(l/e),0). Apply the actual sequence-association qualifications: positive-length grouping and the separate zero-length processor-maximum rule of15.5.2.12 are not interchangeable.

pending.other-type-array-size: PENDING a specific nongeneric procedure with ordinary INTEGER x(2,*) and a defined four-element actual. Safe reads of its four independently known sequence elements are a partial run/effect witness. Exact cardinality remains source/mechanism-gated: no whole SIZE/SHAPE, inferred last extent, fixed-destination proxy or out-of-range boundary test.
pending.other-type-element-tail: PENDING an element of an ordinary simply contiguous nonpointer/nonpolymorphic parent with independently known size and subscript order, such as element3 of six defined INTEGER elements. Check the known safe tail values only. Preserve15.5.2.5/15.5.2.12 restrictions; the x-r+1 boundary is not proved by illegally probing a next element.
pending.default-character-array-sequence: PENDING a defined default-CHARACTER length2 array ['AB','CD','EF'] passed to a length3 assumed-size dummy, checking the two known safe values 'ABC' and 'DEF'. Use language character storage units and exact sequence grouping, not bytes, per-element padding or an ABI copy model. Full-size completeness still needs an honest source/mechanism gate.
pending.default-character-element-substring: PENDING the same simply contiguous parent, with actual element2 and with element2 substring(2:2). For positive dummy lengths, bind t and c from the original array sequence: a length3 dummy can observe the safe value 'DEF' from the substring starting at the fourth character unit. The substring's own length is not the array-tail limit; do not read beyond the justified sequence.
pending.default-character-scalar-sequence: PENDING a default-CHARACTER scalar 'ABCDEF' with dummy length2 and safe values 'AB','CD','EF'; separately a scalar substring uses its own length, not the remaining parent-array rule. Positive e with short/zero-length actual gives no complete group when l<e; do not access an element or call its admission proof of full cardinality.
pending.zero-length-dummy-sequence: PENDING original15.5.2.12p5-p6 source/processor evidence: for default or C CHARACTER dummy length0, the sequence has the processor's maximum supported element count. Never divide by zero, impose a zero-LEN ban, guess HUGE/default-integer capacity, recover this count through a sentinel, or probe a huge boundary. No no-op LEN-only program supplies this size evidence.
pending.c-character-kind-gate: PENDING independent reconciliation of this subclause's default-CHARACTER-specific branches with15.5.2.12's default-or-C-character rules when a supported C_CHAR differs from default and lengths differ. Preserve both texts; do not silently replace 'default' by 'default or C'. C_CHAR can be unavailable, and no fixed kind/storage/companion assumption or profile is introduced.

requirements.oracle: Defined, literal sequence-value observations only within a statically justified safe range, plus explicit source/processor gates for exact cardinality that ordinary assumed-size inquiries cannot observe. These partial witnesses are not represented as completed full-size evidence.
requirements.oracle_limitation: An assumed-rank forwarded SIZE/SHAPE result uses sentinels and cannot recover actual size. Zero dummy length follows its separate source rule, not the positive-length quotient. No compiler consensus, out-of-bounds probe, unavailable value, TRANSFER/address self-oracle or optional-feature skip supplies missing evidence.

requirements.title: Assumed-size rank is one plus the explicit prefix count
requirements.definition: Rank equals one plus the number of explicit-shape-specs. The shared single-star form has rank1 and the explicit-prefix form has rank at least2. Zero available elements do not make an assumed-size array scalar. RANK(*) associates have their separately specified rank1 interpretation.

pending.prefix-rank: PENDING direct actual-dummy RANK observations for one/two scalar prefix dimensions, expecting literal ranks2/3 in complete valid associations. C714_valid__assumed_size already measures rank2 but is a C714 run/positive-control; keep any reuse role-gated, with no clone, evidence-role promotion or unreviewed control-facet designation.
pending.single-star-rank: PENDING a real run/effect with an ordinary INTEGER x(-2:*) and defined safe sequence values, requiring direct RANK(x)=1, including a no-payload empty-actual boundary. Do not inspect RANK of a constructor or destination instead.
pending.rank-star-associate: PENDING a source-qualified SELECT RANK run using an ordinary INTEGER assumed-rank selector associated with an assumed-size dummy. Record actual branch selection, then direct RANK(associate)=1, LBOUND(associate,1)=1 and a justified safe value inside the block. Preserve C1160 and canonical Clause11 ownership; a rank-value branch does not match merely because the selector's rank number agrees.

requirements.oracle: Actual dummy/associate rank and defined observations with independent literal expectations, or an explicit canonical role gate where existing evidence is only a positive control.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No compile-only substitution for run/effect plans, rank-zero inference from empty data, source-use facet credit, or association-name escape. C714/C716 and SELECT RANK constraints remain independent.

requirements.title: An ordinary assumed-size array is not used where its full shape is required
requirements.source: 8.5.8.5 p4 shape-context restriction, physical PDF127, lines17-18
requirements.definition: An assumed-size array does not occur in a context requiring its unavailable full shape. This does not forbid every inquiry, legal sequence association, or an explicitly bounded section. An assumed-rank entity associated with it has distinct intrinsic result conventions, not recovered full shape or size.

pending.unavailable-shape-source: PENDING finite source classification of whole-array operations requiring full shape versus permitted actual-argument contexts under9.5.2. No undefined numeric placeholder, runtime trap or no-op classifier is an oracle.
pending.permitted-inquiries: PENDING exact RANK/LBOUND and earlier-dimension SIZE/UBOUND controls: ordinary SIZE and UBOUND require DIM less than rank, while LBOUND can inquire the last lower bound. Never infer the last extent from those earlier dimensions.
pending.full-inquiry-diagnostic-gate: PENDING canonical intrinsic-argument contrasts such as SHAPE(x) for ordinary x(*), with a valid x(:) repair in the same explicit interface. Preserve4.2p2(7) and the intrinsic owner rather than inventing a required local prose report. Any case needs a precise causal contract and C830-ANCHOR-001 support; no widened span or effect-role retagging.
pending.bounded-sections: PENDING a known safe section of x(2,*) with an explicit last upper limit and independently known available data, e.g. x(:,1:2) with shape[2,2]. This section has a shape without supplying the parent's missing last extent. C930/C931 omission negatives keep their owners and minimally repaired explicit-limit controls.
pending.forwarded-sentinels: PENDING ordinary INTEGER forwarding to a nonpointer nonallocatable assumed-rank dummy, with exact canonical inquiries: for an assumed-size source with first extent2, SHAPE gives[2,-1], SIZE(last)=-1 and total SIZE=-2, not the actual sequence size. LBOUND/UBOUND use their separate assumed-rank rules. TYPE(*) forwarding has C716's additional exclusion; preserve its existing invalid/repair pair and do not clone it.

requirements.oracle: Complete shape-availability and canonical inquiry/association source relations with valid controls. No local mandatory diagnostic or full-size observation is inferred from missing shape.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Do not execute invalid whole queries or use a forwarded sentinel as an index or recovered size. Ordinary and assumed-rank argument restrictions differ. Diagnostic-origin and disjoint-anchor support, source-approved control-facet designations and canonical reuse remain separate gates.

requirements.title: Prefix bounds and the last lower bound are specified independently of the unknown last extent
requirements.source: 8.5.8.5 p5 bound clauses, physical PDF127, lines19-21
requirements.definition: An explicit prefix supplies bounds for the first rank-1 dimensions. The final dimension's lower bound is the specified lower-bound or one if omitted. These known bounds do not create a last upper bound or full shape. Inquiries retain the special assumed-size last-lower rule and ordinary empty-dimension rules.

pending.prefix-bounds: PENDING ordinary x(-1:0,7:*) with a compatible defined sequence: require SIZE(x,DIM=1)=2, UBOUND(x,DIM=1)=0 and LBOUND(x)=[-1,7], plus safe literal-index data checks. No last UBOUND or whole SIZE.
pending.specified-last-lower: PENDING single-star x(-2:*) and a prefixed variant, requiring the literal last lower bound -2 independently of actual array lower bounds and sequence size.
pending.default-last-lower: PENDING x(*) and x(2,*) without a last lower expression, requiring the corresponding lower bound1. Use actual-dummy inquiry, not an observer array's chosen lower bound.
pending.empty-actual-inquiries: PENDING a valid empty actual with x(2,-2:*): the first declared extent remains2 and the last LBOUND remains-2; total empty actual data does not normalize all dummy bounds. A zero-prefix variant x(0,-2:*) has first SIZE/UBOUND0 and lower vector[1,-2]. No element or full-size/shape query is permitted.

requirements.oracle: Real run/effect observations of available prefix and last-lower properties, with independent literal expectations and complete sequence-association/interface premises.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Do not apply implied-shape or ordinary empty-array last-bound normalization to an assumed-size last dimension. No guessed last extent, rank/descriptor proxy, hidden byte model or compile-only effect substitute.

requirements.title: Nonconstant assumed-size bounds are captured on procedure entry
requirements.definition: When an assumed-size array has nonconstant bounds, those bounds are established on procedure entry and are unaffected by redefinition or undefinition of variables during the procedure. This concerns bounds that exist, including the last lower bound, not an invented last upper bound or shape.

pending.prefix-bound-snapshot: PENDING an ordinary specific procedure with prior nonoptional INOUT INTEGER n/lower and x(-2:n,lower:*). Enter with n=-1,lower=5 and a separate four-element defined actual. After changing n, require first SIZE=2, first UBOUND=-1 and safe literal-index data from the original sequence, not a bound recomputed from n.
pending.last-lower-snapshot: PENDING the same complete context, changing lower after entry and requiring LBOUND(x,2)=5 and the original safe element mapping. Expected lower and payload values are literals, not another affected descriptor.
pending.post-undefinition: PENDING controlled undefinition of the separate bound-source scalars through INTENT(OUT) helpers after association is established. Never read those scalars until restored; query only available dummy bounds and safe defined data, with explicit call/event-count observations.
pending.fresh-entries: PENDING two independently prepared calls with prefix extents2 and3, last lowers5 and-3, and separate fixed-size actual sequences of4 and6 elements. Check new entry values and persistence within each call. Do not clone explicit-shape or CHARACTER type-parameter entry-capture cases.

requirements.oracle: Actual run/effect checks of entry-time available bounds and defined sequence values, using independently fixed incoming values and literal expectations before and after source-variable changes.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No last-dimension size/upper query, mutated-input or affected-descriptor oracle, unavailable-value read, coarray/allocator substitute, or compile-only replacement. Ordinary dummy bounds do not become automatic-local C814 cases.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_043.json. Original12base/57fine assumed-size units and45pending facets preserve scalar-prefix/shared-star grammar, declaration and four OUT/type exclusions, sequence association, unavailable full shape, available bounds and entry capture. Safe sequence reads are partial, zero-length grouping uses its separate processor-maximum rule, and distinct C-character-kind/size observability remain source gates. Current role support does not approve a control-facet designation or permit evidence promotion. Historical infrastructure wording was normalized without changing facets, roles or source meaning. No fixture, source-use inventory, compiler observation or facet-completion credit is created.
